id: Madera Fina And Friends-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Madera Fina And Friends
long_description:
The Cubans are back and they have invited a couple of friends and their strings along for the ride this time.

Featuring:
- Rafael Ferrer Noel on congas and vocals
- Roberto Rodriguez Bofill on guitar and vocals
- Seth Boy on double bass
- Tristan Carter on violin

***
Formed 2007, Madera Fina is a Duo Cubano Cubano. Featuring Roberto Rodriguez Bofill on guitar and Rafael Ferrer Noel on percussion, the Wellington-based duo play authentic, traditional Cuban music: trova, son, guaracha, chachacha.

Music from 9:30 - FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band encouraged!

id: Oscar Lavën's Elegant Calamity Orchestra-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Oscar Lavën's Elegant Calamity Orchestra
long_description:
You could drop the needle on any spot and find satisfying, thoroughly involving music. - London Jazz News

An effusive endorsement of New Zealand’s music scene - The List UK

This is a coming together which should be repeated on a regular basis, featuring music deserving of a wide audience. - Jazz Journal

After releasing their recent album 'Elegant Calamity' to a warm international reception and playing to several sold-out crowds, the Elegant Calamity Orchestra makes its return to the Rogue and Vagabond! Led by flamboyant saxophonist Oscar Lavën, the Elegant Calamity Orchestra drawing together a vibrant collection of all-star musicians from various backgrounds under one roof, drawing influence from early American swing, blues, classical music, french cinema, spiritual jazz and 50’s bar-walking rock and roll saxophone.
Prepare to be swept into a surreal, cinematic world by the Elegant Calamity Orchestra; strings, woodwinds, brass, virtuosic percussionists and a deep-digging rhythm section, combining kaleidoscopic orchestral colours with the dangerous spontaneity of a small group. A momentous performance not to be missed.

9pm Downbeat.
Tickets $20

name: Samba Independente
long_description:
October at The Rogue and Vagabond kicks off vibrant, with Samba Independente back on stage — this time joined by a special guest, superb flautist Annalisa Powell, all the way from Australia, adding a fresh new voice and promising some unforgettable musical interplay.
Expect the full spectrum of samba — from roots samba and samba rock to samba-canção, samba paulista, and samba de breque — delivered with the infectious energy Samba Independente is known for. Come catch the band's signature blend of rhythm and groove, this time with a special guest twist.

This time we are: Alda Rezende (vocals), Adriana Gimenes (percussion), Felicien Houet (guitar), Julie Bevan (cavaquinho), Matheus Peres (percussion, vocals), Nikkie Rich (percussion, vocals), Tomas Souza (percussion), and our special guest Annalisa Powell on flute.

Come move to the unmistakable pulse of samba.

Music from 8pm, FREE ENTRY
